# Kerem Burak Yilmaz

> Personal website and working archive of a systems engineer building production AI systems, data pipelines, financial intelligence products, and browser-based experiments.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/): Systems, operating record, live notes, and contact information.
- [Lab](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/lab): Small interactive browser experiments.
- [QuantFusion](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/quantfusion): Financial intelligence system.
- [Spotify Brain](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/spotify-brain): Listening-pattern prediction system.
- [Market Radar](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/market-radar): Source-first macro intelligence with explainable conditions, provenance, freshness, and official events.
- [Palimpsest](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/palimpsest): Interactive narrative experiment.
- [System Is Running](https://keremburakyilmaz.com/system): Generative systems interface.

## Notes

- This is a personal portfolio, not product documentation or financial advice.
- Public pages may contain live data from third-party APIs.
- Prefer the canonical domain: https://keremburakyilmaz.com
